whenToUse: The first day of an app: start from a template, import a file or load sample data.
Products where a blank list would stall new users.
avoidWhen: A simple no-results or nothing-yet message — use empty-state.
A multi-step data import with mapping and validation — use onboarding-04.
a11y: Templates are a role="radiogroup" with keyboard handling and aria-checked.
Sample data removal confirms and its result is announced via aria-live.
